title: Forge model
description: A Forge model of format 5.2.0 or 5.1.0, checked against the schema of the format its `_forge_version` names. For editors: one schema for every model file. Models of the formats 5.0.0 and 1.0.0 are only checked for their version here; `forge validate` checks them in full.

_forge_version.description: Model format version (not the Forge tool version)
